name: kanvas-yuno-sdk-lite
description: Kanvas x Yuno SDK Lite challenge: broken staging code vs. fixed reference implementation

scripts.broken: concurrently -n broken-be,broken-fe -c red,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/staging-broken/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/staging-broken/frontend"
scripts.fixed: concurrently -n fixed-be,fixed-fe -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/fixed/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/fixed/frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock,broken-be,broken-fe,fixed-be,fixed-fe -c yellow,red,magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev -w tools/mock-yuno" "npm run dev -w apps/staging-broken/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/staging-broken/frontend" "npm run dev -w apps/fixed/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/fixed/frontend"
